sn54.3:1.1: bhikkhave bhāvitā bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ||
sn54.3:1.2: katham bhāvitā ca bhikkhave ānāpānasati katham bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā || || 4.
sn54.3:1.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā nisīdati pallaṅkam ābhujitvā ujuṃ kāyam paṇidhāya parimukhaṃ satim upaṭṭhapetvā
sn54.3:1.4: so sato va assasati sato va passasati || || 5--10. Vitthāretabbā || yāva
sn54.3:1.5: paṭinissaggānupassī Assasissamī ti sikkhati || paṭinissaggānupassī Passasissāmīti sikkhati || || 11.
sn54.3:1.6: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave ānāpānasati evam bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mahānisaṃsā ti || || 3.
